workbench_term_clipboard_description: Dialog text when a terminal program asks to set the clipboard; the text follows on the next lines
workbench_term_clipboard_title: Title of the dialog when a terminal program asks to set the clipboard
workbench_term_font_fallback: Toast when the GPU terminal fell back from the font the user chose
workbench_term_gpu_after_restart: Toast when the GPU terminal needs a newer terminal host
workbench_term_pane_ended: Notice over a terminal whose process ended; code is its exit code
workbench_term_pane_gone: Notice over a terminal that no longer exists on the host
workbench_term_pane_host_unreachable: Notice when the terminal host does not answer
workbench_term_pane_raw_protocol_back: Notice over the raw omp terminal; click returns to the chat view
workbench_term_pane_restart_host: Accessible name and hint of the restart button of the host notice
workbench_term_paste_denied: Toast when Ctrl+Shift+V in the terminal cannot read the system clipboard (the webview denied it); key is the plain paste shortcut
workbench_term_search_label: Accessible name of the terminal find field
